result.title: Streaming Virtual Metrology via Lightweight Adaptation under Temporal Distribution Shifts
result.summary: Virtual metrology (VM) aims to estimate costly or delayed metrology variables from heterogeneous sensor signals and in-line measurements, and it acts as a critical component of semiconductor manufacturing. While recent data-driven models have improved VM accuracy, most are trained in batch settings and assume stationary data distributions. In practice, however, production environments evolve continuously due to equipment degradation, process adjustments, and maintenance events, making conventional batch-trained VM models difficult to maintain under temporal distribution shifts. In this work, we propose GRAPE (Global Regression with Adaptive Prediction Enhancement), a practical online learning framework for VM in evolving wafer-processing environments. GRAPE integrates a stable global predictor based on interpretable representations with two lightweight streaming adapters that correct feature-level and environment-level shifts through online updates. Experiments on two real-world semiconductor manufacturing datasets, including chronologically held-out blind-test streams, show that GRAPE improves robustness and generalization under real temporal drift compared with both conventional batch-learning methods and existing online learning baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向半导体制造中的虚拟量测任务，提出 GRAPE 在线学习框架：以可解释表示支撑稳定的全局回归器，再叠加两个轻量流式适配器，通过在线更新分别校正特征层与环境层的时序分布漂移，并在两个真实数据集的时间顺序盲测流上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稳定全局预测器 + 轻量在线适配器分别修正特征层与环境层漂移」可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中推理状态的持续在线校正或视觉证据分布漂移的应对机制，但任务与多模态推理相距较远，借鉴价值需核实。
